correctness.rationale: PASS. In R_{m,n}=K_m square K_n (m,n>=2), N[S] leaves precisely A×B where A,B are missed rows/columns. For a,b>=2 every observed vertex has zero or at least two unseen neighbors, so forcing is impossible; with a<=1 or b<=1 all cells are observed directly or forced in one parallel round. Thus power domination iff used rows≥m-1 or used columns≥n-1. Occupied-row/column inclusion-exclusion gives ordinary all-cardinality polynomial. The line graph L(K_{m,n}) converts connected sensor sets to connected occupied bipartite edge graphs, counted by the standard bivariate labeled exponential formula/first-row-component recurrence. Minimum cardinality d=min(m,n)-1 and both minimum-multiplicity formulas follow by enumerating near-covering rows or columns; sharp maximum failed set (m-2)(n-2) follows support rectangles. Independent exhaustive enumeration for (2,3),(3,3) checked all placements, outcomes, connectivity and coefficients, matching e.g. 3x3 P: z²..z⁹ coefficients 36,84,126,126,84,36,9,1 and connected 18,42,81,117,84,36,9,1.
